image_location_description: Bottom of the image, directly under both feet (small gray pedestal base).

steps.title: Back base layer (8x6)
steps.description: Place 4x Plate 2x6 (3795 DBG) side-by-side to form 8x6.

steps.title: Front base extension
steps.description: Add 4x Plate 1x4 (3710 LBG) to complete an 8x8 footprint.

steps.title: Top layer (back 8x6)
steps.description: Stack 4x Plate 2x6 (3795 DBG) aligned over the back 8x6 area.

steps.title: Top layer front row
steps.description: Front edge: add 2x Tile 1x4 (2431 LBG); behind ends add 2x Plate 1x2 (3023 LBG).

steps.title: Top layer front fill
steps.description: Behind center: add 2x Tile 1x2 (3069b LBG); fill remaining gaps with 2x Plate 1x2 (3023 DBG).

steps.title: Foot lock studs
steps.description: Center top: place 2x Jumper Plate 1x2 (15573: 1 Black, 1 Tan) where feet will sit.
